, starring and directed by , is a survival thriller about a former Special Forces soldier and his combat dog Odin trying to survive the Alaskan wilderness. But the biggest reason this movie works might actually be the dog.
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Heart of the Beast, breaking down the Brad Pitt and Odin relationship, the survival sequences, the action, the emotional core and everything that works and doesn't.
